statement: Counter-example: breaking the cycle with a tiebreak. Picking the more recent record as current reports something that may be false and looks identical to something known. Non-termination is the second failure this rule forbids.

reason: A cycle is a corpus contradicting itself about what replaced what, and there is no defensible way to pick a winner. A naive depth-first walk over the same edges does not terminate at all.
